headline: German Union IG Metall Vows Resistance Against Volkswagen Restructuring Plans
summary: Germany's largest industrial union, IG Metall, promised to fight Volkswagen's proposed cost-cutting measures, which include pay freezes and longer working hours, as the automaker seeks to lower operational costs.
why: Volkswagen is Europe's largest carmaker; labor unrest and restructuring efforts signal broader cost pressures facing European automotive manufacturers.

impacts.name: Volkswagen
impacts.why: Union opposition threatens management's cost-cutting plans and operational stability.
